subject.title: perf(gateway): memoize device pairing reads behind mutation invalidation

question: Should maintainers accept the device-pairing store as the canonical cache owner after the exact PR head completes CI and its external-write freshness contract is reviewed?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the change trades repeated persisted-state reads for a process-local cache whose correctness relies on SQLite connection-validity semantics.

options.title: Accept the store-owned cache
options.body: Merge after the exact head completes checks if maintainers agree that mutation invalidation plus SQLite validity tokens is the intended freshness contract.

options.title: Keep request-scoped reads only
options.body: Decline this cache layer if maintainers prefer the prior per-dispatch pairing snapshot despite the residual catalog cost.

recommendation.title: Accept the store-owned cache
recommendation.body: Merge after the exact head completes checks if maintainers agree that mutation invalidation plus SQLite validity tokens is the intended freshness contract.
